title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 02
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment replacement' criteria include
options: The colour and make of the rescue equipment
Availability of the spare parts in store
The purchase cost and the annual upkeep of the equipment
Age, condition, and manufacturer recommendations
questions.solution: Replacement depends on age, condition, manufacturer specs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'igneous intrusion' in coal seams causes
options: Displacement of the seam along a fault plane
A reduction in the thickness of the overburden
Alteration of coal quality and seam continuity
Folding of the overlying rock strata above the seam
questions.solution: Igneous intrusions alter coal quality and seam continuity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spontaneous heating' of coal occurs because
options: Coal absorbs moisture from the air
Coal reacts with oxygen and generates heat
Coal absorbs oxygen slowly at low temperature
The coal seam remains cold and inert
questions.solution: Spontaneous heating occurs when coal reacts with oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The cable testing in mines must be done by
options: The mine electrician holding a valid licence
The winding engineman of the main shaft
Competent persons using approved testing equipment
The surface watchman of the mine surface works area
questions.solution: Competent persons using approved testing equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'filling factor' in stowing represents
options: The ratio of sand to water used in the stowing slurry
Ratio of coal extracted to material used
Ratio of air to water in the pipeline
Percentage of goaf filled with stowing material
questions.solution: Filling factor is percentage of goaf filled with material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water inflow monitoring' in mines involves
options: One-time measurement at the start of a shift
Monitoring of the water inflow only once a year
Regular measurement and recording of water inflow rates
Measuring of the water inflow rate only in the rainy season
questions.solution: Water inflow is monitored regularly for early warning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'seam thickness' affects
options: Applies to the sedimentary rock formations
Mining method selection and economic viability
Works only for the surface coal deposits
Specific to the metamorphic rock terrain around it
questions.solution: Seam thickness affects mining method and economics.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas detection' in mines uses
options: Gas detectors and monitoring instruments
Detection by listening to the air
Detection by the smell and taste of gas
Measuring the temperature in the workings
questions.solution: Gas detection uses detectors and monitoring instruments.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'level instrument' must be checked for
options: Temporary adjustments - bubble, crosshair, and line of sight
Measurement of the air velocity in the roadways
Mapping of the flow paths of the underground water in the mine
Testing of the stability of the mine roof strata
questions.solution: Temporary adjustments - bubble, crosshair, and line of sight.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'flyrock radius' is influenced by
options: Burden, stemming, and charge characteristics
Distance of the nearest dwelling nearby
Direction of the prevailing wind in the area
Time of the day at which firing is done
questions.solution: Flyrock depends on burden, stemming, and charge characteristics.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar who finds a dangerous occurrence must
options: Wait until the end of that shift to report
Continue the normal work in that same place
Immediately stop work, withdraw persons, and report
Record the occurrence in the book at the end of the shift
questions.solution: Immediate action is required for dangerous occurrences.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary purpose of ventilation in underground mines is to
options: Provide fresh air and remove hazardous gases, dust, and heat
Removal of the harmful gases and dust from the mine
Cooling of the underground working environment inside the mine
Control of the humidity in the underground workings
questions.solution: Provide fresh air and remove hazardous gases, dust, and heat.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'proven reserve' of coal is
options: Demonstrated by detailed exploration and sampling
Inferred from the seam thickness alone
Inferred from the surface outcrops of seams
Indicated by the regional geological mapping
questions.solution: Proven reserves are demonstrated by detailed exploration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pit bottom' is the
options: The highest bench level in the pit
The mid slope level of the working pit
Deepest working level of the mine
The shallowest point within the mine pit
questions.solution: Pit bottom is the deepest active working level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine plan scale' typically used for working plans is

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The spray nozzles for dust suppression must be
options: Cleaned and maintained regularly
Rated for the full design water pressure
Fitted only during the monsoon
Repainted once every year with care
questions.solution: Cleaned and maintained regularly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A continuous miner is used for
options: Mechanized extraction of coal from the face
Only for the roof bolting work done at the face
Only for the stone drifting operations
For the surface haulage of mined coal
questions.solution: Mechanized extraction of coal from the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum number of persons in a mine rescue team is
questions.solution: Minimum 5 persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue communication' underground uses
options: Intrinsic safety telephones and communication systems
Ordinary mobile phones used by the mine staff
Signalling by open flame or by shouting aloud
Announcements over the public address system
questions.solution: Rescue communication uses intrinsic safety telephones.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'transport of explosives' in mines must follow
options: Prescribed regulations for safe handling and storage
Use of the shortest possible route to the face
Handing over the explosives to any one of the mine workers
Carrying the explosives with the detonators
questions.solution: Prescribed regulations for safe handling.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coking coal' is used for
options: Blending with low rank coal for coke
Fertiliser and cement manufacture
Making coke for iron and steel industry
Power generation in the thermal plants
questions.solution: Coking coal is used to make coke for iron/steel industry.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'auxiliary fan' is used to
options: Cooling of the mine workings and of the men
Replacing of the main ventilation fan used
Heating of the mine workings and of the men
Supplement ventilation in specific areas
questions.solution: Auxiliary fans supplement ventilation in specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'theodolite' in mine surveying is used to measure
options: Determination of the least count
Horizontal and vertical angles
Direct measurement of gas percentage
Measurement of the horizontal distance
questions.solution: Measures horizontal and vertical angles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The frequency of stone dust application depends on
options: The number of the holidays observed
The rate of dust generation and accumulation
The colour of the coal and of the seam
The personal wish of the mine manager
questions.solution: Depends on rate of dust generation and accumulation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, the incombustible dust used for dust treatment in a mine shall not contain more than what percentage of free silica?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 144(4)(a): incombustible dust used for dust treatment shall not contain more than 5% of free silica.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A motor starter in a mine must have
options: Automatic restart capability
A manual switch or a manual handle
Overload and short circuit protection
Insulation testing of the motor windings
questions.solution: Overload and short circuit protection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A face pump is used to
options: Remove water accumulation at the coal face
Ventilation of the coal face
Pumping of water for drinking purposes
Support of the roof and the face area
questions.solution: Removes water accumulation at the coal face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A cable joint in a mine must be
options: Made by competent persons using approved methods
Repaired with the insulating tape alone
Sealed with the wax of a burnt candle
Made by the shot firer in that panel
questions.solution: Made by competent persons using approved methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before winding persons, the winding engine must be
options: Not tested before the winding
Tested by running loaded
Checked by the banksman only
Tested by running empty
questions.solution: Testing by running empty before winding persons is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Pit dewatering involves
options: Allowing the water to stand in the pit
Sealing of the pit bottom with stoppings
Removing groundwater for dry working conditions
Storing of the mine water in the benches of the pit
questions.solution: Dewatering removes groundwater for safe working.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A loading cycle consists of
options: Digging, swinging, dumping, returning
Drilling, blasting, mucking, hauling
Filling, tamping, stemming, and firing of the hole
Cutting, loading, hauling, dumping
questions.solution: Loading cycle includes dig, swing, dump, return.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the working place has
options: Adequate ventilation before persons enter
Adequate natural lighting
Ventilation arranged only at night time
No escape route or exit from the place
questions.solution: Adequate ventilation is required before persons enter.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face ventilation' is designed to
options: Reduction of the humidity in the face
Cooling of the mine workings and men
Dilute and remove gases from working face
Increase of the temperature at the face
questions.solution: Face ventilation dilutes and removes gases from face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fault problem' in mining involves determining
options: The displacement and direction of the fault to plan the working
The tonnage of coal already despatched from the district
The grade of the overburden in the working opencast pit
The hourly capacity of the belt conveyor fitted
questions.solution: Displacement and direction to plan working.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing face' in underground mining is where
options: Ventilation of the working face occurs
Haulage of the coal to the pit bottom
Extraction of the coal from the face
Stowing material is deposited into goaf
questions.solution: Stowing face is where material is deposited into goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'raise borer' is used to
options: Ventilation of the underground mine workings
Drilling of the horizontal holes in rock
Excavate vertical or inclined openings between levels
Draining of the water from the mine sump
questions.solution: Raise borers excavate vertical or inclined openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety gear' of a man riding system includes
options: Seat belts or safety chains for each passenger
A sun roof fitted on the man riding car
Improved comfort of the seats fitted in the car
Headlights meant for the surface roads
questions.solution: Seat belts or safety chains for each passenger.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system operating in a gassy mine must use
options: A diesel locomotive without a flame trap
Vehicles certified for surface use only
A vehicle certified for opencast use
Intrinsically safe or flameproof vehicles
questions.solution: Intrinsically safe or flameproof vehicles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A sirdar who notices subsidence must
options: Note it in the diary and continue the work
Record it in the diary and carry on work
Wait until the very beginning of the next working shift
Immediately report and take precautionary measures
questions.solution: Immediate reporting and precautionary measures are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The inflow of water into a mine can be detected by
options: A sudden rise in the wind velocity of the workings
A clearly visible change in the colour of the roof strata in the goaf
An increase in the temperature of the mined-out goaf
Sudden increase in pump load, wet spots, or change in water quality
questions.solution: Sudden increase in pump load, wet spots, or change in water quality.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment testing records' must be
options: Maintained with dates, results, and corrective actions
Kept only in the personal notebook kept by the sirdar
Discarded after each practice of the quarter
Maintained only by the equipment manufacturer
questions.solution: Testing records must be maintained with dates and results.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'flood gate' in a mine is used to
options: An increase in the rate of pumping out
Isolate sections in case of water inrush
Ventilation of the mine workings there
Draining of the water from the mine workings
questions.solution: Isolates sections in case of water inrush.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the flame safety lamp
options: Is only for display
Is only for illumination
Is not used in gassy seams at all
Is tested for accuracy before use
questions.solution: The flame safety lamp must be tested for accuracy (goes no-go test) before use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mechanical stowing' uses
options: Explosive charges placed in the holes
Hand picking of the material by workers
Mechanical equipment like conveyors and loaders
Hand barrows and manual carrying by hand
questions.solution: Mechanical stowing uses equipment like conveyors and loaders.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An isolated stone dust barrier is installed
options: At every roadway intersection inside the mine
At specific intervals along the main and return airways
At the surface plant of the mine workings
At the bottom of the working open cast pit
questions.solution: At specific intervals along main and return airways.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'sump' in a mine is used to
options: Collect water for pumping to surface
Storage of the diesel fuel at the face
Serve as an emergency exit route
Holding of the water used for drilling
questions.solution: Collects water for pumping to surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, in a gassy seam of the second or third degree, precautions against the extension of an ignition or explosion from one part of the mine to another shall be taken by providing
options: Stone dust barriers
Additional auxiliary fans
Water drenching
More stoppings in the pit
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 146 requires stone dust barriers in gassy seams of the second or third degree, and in development workings in a first-degree gassy seam where inflammable gas may occur in dangerous quantities, to prevent an ignition or explosion from extending from one part of the mine to the other.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'flame safety lamp' is used to detect
options: Only the temperature of the mine air
Only the humidity of the mine air
Presence of methane and oxygen deficiency
The velocity of the air current flowing
questions.solution: Presence of methane and oxygen deficiency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must see that the fire-fighting equipment in his district is
options: Available and in working order
Stored in the office and kept locked
Replaced once every year only
Counted and reported daily to the manager
questions.solution: Fire-fighting equipment must be kept available and maintained in working order at convenient points both on surface and belowground (CMR 2017 Regulation 139).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar shall ensure that the shot firer does not
options: Permit the use of any explosive at the working face area
Allow him to carry more explosive than the need requires
Allow him to re-enter the face after the firing of the shot is completed
Commence shot firing until all persons are removed to a safe distance
questions.solution: Shot firing must not commence until all persons are at a safe distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'accident triangle' or 'Heinrich's triangle' shows the relationship between
options: The ratio of the number of accidents to the man hours worked
Near misses, minor injuries, and serious/fatal injuries
The sequence of events leading to a single casualty
The monetary cost of accidents to the owner
questions.solution: Shows relationship between near misses, minor injuries, and serious/fatal injuries.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'timber prop' in underground mines is used for
options: Transport of the mined coal from the face
Temporary support of roof and floor
Drainage of the water from the workings
Blasting of the coal at the face
questions.solution: Timber props provide temporary support for roof and floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'aquifer' in mining refers to
options: A drainage channel cut into the seam
A water barrier built in the roadway
A water-bearing geological formation
A sump at the lowest point of the mine
questions.solution: A water-bearing geological formation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'de-watering plan' for a mine must include
options: Only the name of the mine manager of the open pit
Only the number of persons employed on the surface
Pump locations, capacity, piping layout, and emergency procedures
Only the blasting schedule prepared for each mine week
questions.solution: Pump locations, capacity, piping, and emergency procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'returns of accidents' must be maintained by
options: The workers' union of that mine
The inspector of mines of the region
The owner or the appointed agent of the mine
The manager as per prescribed format
questions.solution: The manager must maintain returns of accidents.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A stone dust barrier that has been triggered must be
options: Left in the same condition
Immediately renewed and recharged
Painted over with the mine paint
Stored in the store for reuse
questions.solution: Immediately renewed and recharged.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A flameproof enclosure can withstand
options: Protection of the electrical equipment fitted within the box
Control of the dust emissions generated in the mine roadways
Internal explosion without allowing it to escape to the surrounding atmosphere
Mechanical shock without any visible damage to the enclosure
questions.solution: Internal explosion without allowing it to escape.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: When taking charge, the sirdar must
options: Check and satisfy himself about the safety conditions
Rely on the previous sirdar's report alone
Not check anything in the working place at all
Wait for the written instructions of the manager
questions.solution: The sirdar must check and satisfy himself about safety conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of persons permitted in a winding cage depends on
options: A fixed number set by the operator
Twenty persons in every case always
The decision taken by the operator
The designed capacity and safe working load
questions.solution: Depends on designed capacity and safe working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence' above a stowed area is generally
options: Less than a caved area
Equal to the height of the seam
More than caved area
Same as that of a caved area
questions.solution: Generally less than a caved area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire emergency communication' in mines must be
options: No communication system is needed at all inside the mine
Installed only in the office of the manager
Used only once a month by the mine sirdar
Reliable, tested, and accessible during emergencies
questions.solution: Emergency communication must be reliable and tested.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire dam' in mines is built to
options: Provide the necessary support to the workings
Increase of the ventilation air flow
Increase of the air flow in the mine
Seal off fire area and prevent spread
questions.solution: Fire dams seal off fire areas to prevent spread.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'booster fan' is used to
options: Assist the main fan in boosting air pressure in a section
Control of the roof conditions at the working face
Supply of water to the underground mine workings
Replacement of the main ventilation fan of the mine
questions.solution: Assists the main fan in boosting air pressure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main danger from electrical equipment in coal mines is
options: Electromagnetic interference with mine telephones
Excessive noise levels at the switchgear panels
Overheating of the transformer oil
Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat
questions.solution: Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The voltage for operating SDL/LHD is typically
options: 220 V or 220 kV AC
33 kV or 330 V AC
125 V or 250 V DC
250V DC or 440V AC
questions.solution: Typically 250V DC or 440V AC.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam maintenance' includes
options: Painting of the water dams at least once every year
Inspection of the water dams only after the heavy rains fall there
Regular inspection, repair of seepage, and drainage clearing
Replacement of the water dams every five years in use
questions.solution: Dam maintenance includes inspection, repair, drainage clearing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be discarded if
options: It shows signs of deterioration or damage beyond limits
It has already been used for a very long time
After ten full years of service in the underground mine workings
It is merely about five years of service age
questions.solution: Must be discarded if deterioration or damage exceeds limits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The electrical maintenance register must contain
options: Details of all maintenance activities, tests, and results
Thermal insulation properties of the cables and all their ends
Mechanical strength of the cable materials used
The personal details of all the underground workers
questions.solution: Details of all maintenance activities, tests, and results.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The notice of a dangerous occurrence or accident in or about a mine is required to be given under
options: CMR 2017 Regulation 8
CMR 2017 Regulation 104
CMR 2017 Regulation 115
CMR 2017 Regulation 144
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 8 (Notice of dangerous occurrence or accident) requires reporting of accidents causing loss of life or serious bodily injury, and of dangerous occurrences, in or about a mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'risk assessment' in a mine involves
options: Identifying hazards, assessing risks, and implementing controls
Writing the accident report only after the accident has occurred
Only examining the machinery and plant in the mine
Consulting only the safety officer appointed there
questions.solution: Identifying hazards, assessing risks, and implementing controls.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'maximum duration' a rescue team can operate underground with breathing apparatus is limited by
options: The size of the underground rescue station in the mine there
The decision taken by the mine manager there
The oxygen supply capacity of the breathing apparatus
The distance of the working place from the shaft
questions.solution: The oxygen supply capacity of the breathing apparatus.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fan pressure' in mine ventilation is
options: Regulate the air temperature only
Zero or a negligible pressure value
Independent of the quantity of air flowing
The pressure difference created by the fan
questions.solution: Fan pressure is the pressure difference created by the fan.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Factor of Risk' (FER) in coal mines is calculated as
options: Methane percentage ÷ Lower Explosive Limit
Temperature multiplied by the pressure
Humidity multiplied by the temperature
Methane percentage × dust concentration
questions.solution: FER = Methane percentage / Lower Explosive Limit (5% for methane).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'inundation rescue equipment' in mines must include
options: Diesel generators and power units only
Drilling machines and jumbo sets only
Explosive stores and their underground magazines
Pumps, pipes, and communication systems
questions.solution: Rescue equipment includes pumps, pipes, communication systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underground refuge chamber' is used to
options: Provide temporary shelter for miners trapped underground
Storage of the explosives in a mine surface storage magazine
Housing of the main ventilation fan in the mine
Storage of the mining equipment and the spares
questions.solution: Provides temporary shelter for trapped miners.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a shot-firer must hold, in addition to a gas-testing certificate:
options: An Overman's or Sirdar's certificate
A Manager's First Class certificate only
An Engine Driver's certificate
A Surveyor or a mine survey certificate
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 190: a shot-firer holds a gas-testing certificate and an Overman's or Sirdar's certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: If a sirdar's district is of such a size that it cannot be examined within the required time, the matter is referred to:
options: The manager of the mine
The overman of the mine
The safety officer
The Chief Inspector
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: if the district is too large to be examined in time, the matter is referred to the Chief Inspector for a decision.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire watch' in a mine after a fire incident must continue until
options: For at least three hours after the fire
Until the end of that particular shift
For at least forty eight hours after the fire is put out
The area is declared safe by a competent person
questions.solution: Until the area is declared safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must report to the manager if he finds that
options: The production output of that mine is low
There is a contravention of the Act or regulations
The mine canteen services have been closed
The mine workers are often very late for reporting duty
questions.solution: Any contravention of the Act or regulations must be reported.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stone dust must be distributed
options: On the roadway floor at the end of the shift
Along the rib intersections where dust settles
On the roof of the main gate roadway
On all surfaces - roof, sides, and floor
questions.solution: Distribution on all surfaces is required.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A table shows department strength: Safety=20, Production=50, Maintenance=30. Total employees?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The highest dam in India is
options: Nagar Sagar
Hirakud Dam
Bhakra Dam
Tehri Dam
questions.solution: Tehri Dam in Uttarakhand is the highest.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The maximum strength of Lok Sabha is
questions.solution: Maximum strength is 552.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine water' treatment and use is important for
options: Only for washing the machinery
Only for the suppression of dust
Community water supply and irrigation
Storing in underground sumps
questions.solution: Community water supply and irrigation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's welfare schemes' for workers include
options: Healthcare, education, housing, and provident fund
Discipline charges for the late reporting of the workers
Only a free coal quota allotted to each employee
Only an annual bonus linked to district output
questions.solution: Healthcare, education, housing, and provident fund.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The headquarters of Coal India Limited is in
options: Ranchi
Kolkata
Singrauli
New Delhi
questions.solution: CIL headquarters is in Kolkata, West Bengal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The share of coal in India's electricity generation is approximately
questions.solution: Coal accounts for about 70% of India's electricity generation through thermal power plants.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'carbon capture and storage' (CCS) technology involves
options: Burning of the coal at much lower temperatures in the kiln
Using only the renewable sources of energy
Capturing CO2 emissions and storing them underground
Storing of the coal in sealed storage silos
questions.solution: Capturing CO2 and storing underground.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle' (PSLV) is used by ISRO for
options: Launching satellites into polar orbit
Sending astronauts to the Moon
Manned space missions of India
Launching of rockets from under water
questions.solution: Launching satellites into polar orbit.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'royalty' on coal is paid by
options: Payments by the workers to management
Payments made to the DGMS
Mine lessee to State Government
Payments by the State to the Central
questions.solution: Royalty is paid by the mine lessee to the State Government.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's e-Nivaran' portal is for
options: Online grievance redressal of coal sector issues
Online booking of the coal rakes by rail
Conducting the e-Auction of coal online
Issuing of the employee identity cards daily
questions.solution: Online grievance redressal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Mangalyaan' mission was launched by ISRO in
questions.solution: Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) was launched by ISRO on 5 November 2013; it entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A pie chart: A=40%, B=30%, C=20%, D=10%. If total = 500, value of A?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The average of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 is

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The minimum age to become a member of Rajya Sabha is
options: 35 years
40 years
25 years
30 years
questions.solution: Minimum age is 30 years.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: 'Excavate' means the same as
options: Dig
Cover
Build
Fill
questions.solution: Excavate means to dig.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph: Month 1 = 80, Month 2 = 90, Month 3 = 100, Month 4 = 110. Monthly growth rate?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Indian Premier League (IPL) started in
questions.solution: IPL started in 2008.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Amazon River is in
options: South America
Asia continent
Africa continent
North America
